svg.title: UML Class Diagram — E-commerce System
svg.desc: Class diagram showing User, Customer, Admin, Order, OrderItem, Product, and Payment with relationships including inheritance, association, aggregation, and composition.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain the User class in more detail')
sendPrompt('What does the Admin class manage?')
sendPrompt('How does OrderItem connect Order and Product?')
sendPrompt('What payment methods should Payment support?')
